### Bible Pathways 07/13/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-07-or-13-or-2002-1141014.html
Passage: Psalm 107:6-9, 20
Points:
- Although Israel repeatedly rebelled and suffered, God mercifully responded whenever they cried out in trouble.
- God's primary instrument for deliverance and healing is sending forth His Word.
- The living Word is Jesus Christ, who sustains creation and provides spiritual and physical renewal.
- Believing and applying God's written Word satisfies the hungry soul and meets every human need.
- Just as Christ subdued the raging winds at sea, He brings peace to life's storms.
